data.subject: Local Ledger research pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Fourthstone's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ISTR and AVBH.

ISTR reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $53.2M versus $35.4M a year earlier (+50.5% y/y). (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1602658/000143774926026348/0001437749-26-026348-index.htm)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
